I said to send people to Bill and Fleur's at Shell Cottage because that's where we'd go to be safe. I trust them and I say it plain and quick.

Book7-chapter23_Sc2.source: "There’s no way out, Ron," said Luna, "The cellar is completely escape-proof."
Book7-chapter23_Sc2.description: I tried to Disapparate without a wand in panic. I know I panic, but I also know I won't give up looking for any chance to save my friends.

Book7-chapter25_Sc3.source: "Well, I think it’s genius," said Ron, standing up again. "Let’s go and tell him."
Book7-chapter25_Sc3.description: Blimey, I reckon it's brilliant. Let's go and tell him now, come on.

Book7-chapter22_Sc4.source: "Bill told me Lupin’s living with Tonks again! And apparently she’s getting pretty big too."
Book7-chapter22_Sc4.description: Blimey, Lupin's living with Tonks again and she's getting big. That's mental and means they're settling back together.

Book7-chapter22_Sc4.source: "At least he’s still alive!" muttered Ron.
Book7-chapter22_Sc4.description: At least Hagrid's alive. That's a relief even if he's on the run after that Support Harry Potter thing.

Book7-chapter22_Sc4.source: "I’m not being 'Rodent,' no way, I told you I wanted to be 'Rapier'!"
Book7-chapter22_Sc4.description: Hearing Fred muck about on air reminds me to stay calm. If we can laugh at all this, maybe we're tougher than the Death Eaters expect.

Book7-chapter25_Sc2.source: "He’s having a laugh. We can’t let him have that sword."
Book7-chapter25_Sc2.description: Blimey, I reckon Griphook's having a laugh if he expects to walk off with our sword.

Book7-chapter25_Sc2.source: "It’ll be one of those goblin stories," said Ron, "about how the wizards are always trying to get one over on them. I suppose we should think ourselves lucky he hasn’t asked for one of our wands."
Book7-chapter25_Sc2.description: Goblins always have their slant on things. I reckon they're always saying we cheated them, but still, lucky it's not our wands he's after.

Book7-chapter25_Sc2.source: "Yeah, but we could scarper before he realizes —"
Book7-chapter25_Sc2.description: I thought we could nick the sword and scarper before he knows, which was a stupid idea when you think about it.

Book7-chapter25_Sc2.source: "Brilliant. I’ll go and get one of our other ancient goblin-made swords and you can gift wrap it."
Book7-chapter25_Sc2.description: Alright, fine. If we can't pull a fast one, I was thinking we could replace it with another goblin-made sword and hope that does the job.

Book7-chapter25_Sc1.source: I’ll bet the Lestranges have got loads of stuff, you can take your pick once we get into the vault
Book7-chapter25_Sc1.description: I thought we could offer him other treasure from the Lestrange vault to make him happy. I was trying to be practical and quick about it.

Book7-chapter25_Sc1.source: It was made for him, wasn't it? No one’s
Book7-chapter25_Sc1.description: I assumed the sword was made for Gryffindor and belonged to us. I didn't know goblins claimed prior ownership.

Book7-chapter25_Sc1.source: Wizarding arrogance again! That sword was Ragnuk the First's, taken from him by Godric Gryffindor
Book7-chapter25_Sc1.description: Alright, so goblins see us as arrogant for assuming the sword is ours. I can't just shrug off their claim now. That's awkward.

Book7-chapter25_Sc1.source: I am not a thief, boy! I am not trying to procure treasures to which I have no right!
Book7-chapter25_Sc1.description: I got called out for suggesting we take stuff that isn't ours. I realised my offhand plan sounded wrong and it upset him.

Book7-chapter25_Sc5.description: Blimey, there's a baby. I'm gobsmacked and proper pleased for them.

Book7-chapter25_Sc5.source: ["I — yeah — blimey —" (Ron said this as if he had never heard of such a thing before)]
Book7-chapter25_Sc5.description: I keep saying blimey because I'm stunned. It's crazy but brilliant news.

Book7-chapter22_Sc3.source: "I dunno . . . I mean . . . bits of it sort of fit together"
Book7-chapter22_Sc3.description: I can't deny that some of what Harry says lines up, but it doesn't add up completely for me.

Book7-chapter22_Sc3.source: "I think we’re supposed to get rid of Horcruxes, Harry. That’s what Dumbledore told us to do."
Book7-chapter22_Sc3.description: We're here to destroy Horcruxes. That's the point of all this, and we shouldn't get sidetracked by Hallows talk.

Book7-chapter22_Sc3.source: "I’ve got it, I’ve got it! Password was ‘Albus’! Get in here, Harry!"
Book7-chapter22_Sc3.description: I managed to crack the Potterwatch password. It was 'Albus' and we got back on the radio. That was a proper bit of luck.
Well, you never know where a lead might take you, so we keep poking about places Tom might've been. Keep moving, keep trying.

Book7-chapter24_Sc2.description: Blimey, I know it has been done before. Gringotts has been breached in the past, so it is not impossible.

Book7-chapter24_Sc2.source: "Well, goblins can do magic without wands," said Ron.
Book7-chapter24_Sc2.description: Bloody hell, goblins do their own kind of magic and they think wizards hoard wandlore. That argument matters to them.

Book7-chapter24_Sc2.source: "Little git," whispered Ron. "He’s enjoying keeping us hanging."
Book7-chapter24_Sc2.description: He’s winding us up. I don’t trust Griphook to decide quickly. We need to push him, but carefully.

Book7-chapter24_Sc2.source: "You can’t want You-Know-Who defeated more than we do, Griphook!"
Book7-chapter24_Sc2.description: Blimey, we all want You-Know-Who gone. I made that plain to try to win Griphook over and show we are on the same side.

Book7-chapter24_Sc1.source: How are you? You were amazing - coming up with that story when she was hurting you like that -
Book7-chapter24_Sc1.description: I saw Hermione suffer and I know she was brave. I'm proud of her and I'll stick by her.
Dobby mattered to us. I'm gutted he died and I want to show respect, even if I can't find the words.

Book7-chapter24_Sc1.source: What are we doing now, Harry?
Book7-chapter24_Sc1.description: I'm ready to follow Harry. If he says it's urgent, then it is. I'll be there, even if I don't know every detail.

Book7-chapter28_Sc1.description: Great idea. I agree, let's get out of here and not hang around.

Book7-chapter27_Sc1.source: "What do you reckon it’s looking for?" Ron yelled as they flew farther and farther north.
Book7-chapter27_Sc1.description: What d'you reckon it's looking for? Seriously, what's it after up here?

Book7-chapter24_Sc3.source: "So I should use this one?" said Ron, pulling Wormtail’s wand out of his pocket and handing it to Ollivander. "Chestnut and dragon heartstring. Nine-and-a-quarter inches. Brittle. I was forced to make this shortly after my kidnapping, for Peter Pettigrew."
Book7-chapter24_Sc3.description: I now know the wand I took from Wormtail was made for him and is brittle, but if I won it then it's more likely to work for me than a random wand.

Book7-chapter24_Sc3.source: "But then, let’s go!" said Ron urgently. "Harry, let’s go and get it before he does!"
Book7-chapter24_Sc3.description: Blimey, when I find out Voldemort is going for the Elder Wand I want to go and snatch it back right now. We should stop him.

Book7-chapter24_Sc3.source: "The unbeatable wand, Harry!" moaned Ron. "I’m not supposed to . . . I’m supposed to get the Horcruxes."
Book7-chapter24_Sc3.description: I feel torn. I want the unbeatable wand and I think it'd fix everything, but I remember Dumbledore wanted Harry to focus on the Horcruxes. I can't stop caring about both.

Book7-chapter27_Sc2.source: Is it my imagination, or are we losing height?
Book7-chapter27_Sc2.description: Blimey, we're losing height, aren't we?

Book7-chapter26_Sc3.description: I spot things when I'm excited. I call them out straight away and want a plan to get them.

Book7-chapter26_Sc3.source: "And how the hell are we going to get up there without touching anything?"
Book7-chapter26_Sc3.description: I worry about practicalities and point out obvious problems. Can't just stand there, someone needs to work out how to reach it.

Book7-chapter26_Sc3.source: "Where’s the sword? It had the cup on it!"
Book7-chapter26_Sc3.description: When something goes wrong I shout what's missing and try to grab it back. I react loud and fast in a crisis.
I will push my mates to move even when I'm scared. I might swear and yell, but I stick with them and shove everyone into action.

Book7-chapter27_Sc4.source: "You sound like Hagrid," said Ron. "It’s a dragon, Hermione, it can look after itself. It’s us we need to worry about." "Well, I don’t know how to break this to you," said Ron, "but I think they might have noticed we broke into Gringotts."
Book7-chapter27_Sc4.description: Blimey, forget the dragon — it can look after itself. It's us I'm worried about. I don't know how to break this to you but I reckon they've noticed we broke into Gringotts.

Book7-chapter29_Sc1.description: Blimey, when did this tunnel appear? I didn't even know about it until now.

Book7-chapter29_Sc1.source: "It isn't on the Marauder's Map, is it, Harry? I thought there were only seven passages in and out of school?"
Book7-chapter29_Sc1.description: This passage isn't on the Marauder's Map and we were told there were only seven ways in and out. That's odd and worrying.

Book7-chapter29_Sc1.source: "Released it into the wild," said Ron. "Hermione was all for keeping it as a pet —"
Book7-chapter29_Sc1.description: We set the dragon free. I still think Hermione was mad to want it as a pet, but fair play, freeing it was the right thing.

Book7-chapter27_Sc3.source: Well, on the upside, we got the Horcrux. On the downside -
Book7-chapter27_Sc3.description: We got the Horcrux, which is the upside, but on the downside we don't have the sword
You sound like Hagrid, Hermione, I mean you're worrying about the dragon like he would

Book7-chapter27_Sc3.source: It's a dragon, Hermione, it can look after itself
Book7-chapter27_Sc3.description: It's a dragon, Hermione, it can look after itself. Don't get too worked up about it

Book7-chapter28_Sc3.source: "He, Ron, and Hermione retreated down the side street, groping their way along the wall, trying not to make a sound."
Book7-chapter28_Sc3.description: Blimey, we were feeling our way down the wall, trying to stay quiet. I was properly terrified of those things.

Book7-chapter26_Sc2.source: "Wait — Bogrod!" Another goblin came scurrying around the counter. "We have instructions," he said with a bow to Hermione."
Book7-chapter26_Sc2.description: Blimey, the goblins obey instructions to the letter. If they think there are orders, they'll follow them.

Book7-chapter26_Sc2.source: "We need him," said Griphook, "we cannot enter the vault without a Gringotts goblin. And we need the Clankers!"
Book7-chapter26_Sc2.description: We need a goblin and those Clankers to get past that dragon. That's the only way in.

Book7-chapter26_Sc2.source: "The Thief’s Downfall!" said Griphook..."It washes away all enchantment, all magical concealment!"
Book7-chapter26_Sc2.description: Bloody hell, that thing strips every trick off you. You can't rely on disguises down there.
I expect we need light and quick thinking when we get inside. We have to be ready to search fast.

Book7-chapter28_Sc5.source: "The silver doe!" he said excitedly. "Was that you too?"
Book7-chapter28_Sc5.description: Blimey, that silver doe was sent to us. I thought it was magical help showing the way.

Book7-chapter28_Sc5.source: "Brains like that, you could be a Death Eater, son. Haven’t I just proved my Patronus is a goat?"
Book7-chapter28_Sc5.description: Right then, Aberforth joked his Patronus looked like a goat. So not everything people say about Patronuses is straightforward.
Bloody hell, after all that I was starving. Food matters when you’re knackered and stressed, simple as that.

Book7-chapter29_Sc2.source: "Blimey, Neville," said Ron, "there’s a time and a place for getting a smart mouth."
Book7-chapter29_Sc2.description: Blimey, Neville's been talking back a lot. He's been cheeky enough to get punished for it, so they're making examples of people who mouth off.

Book7-chapter29_Sc2.source: "No kidding," muttered Ron, as the passage began to slope upward.
Book7-chapter29_Sc2.description: No kidding, what they're doing is terrifying. If Michael got that for freeing someone, I wouldn't expect anyone to keep risking that once it got that bad.

Book7-chapter29_Sc2.source: "Amycus, the bloke, he teaches what used to be Defense Against the Dark Arts, except now it’s just the Dark Arts. We’re supposed to practice the Cruciatus Curse on people who’ve earned detentions —"
Book7-chapter29_Sc2.description: Bloody hell, the teaching's been perverted. They actually force kids to use the Cruciatus as punishment. That's sick.

Book7-chapter29_Sc3.source: "They what?" said Harry, Ron, and Hermione together.
Book7-chapter29_Sc3.description: They actually went for Neville's gran. Blimey, that's low even for them.

Book7-chapter29_Sc3.source: "Only thing was, once they realized they had no hold over me, they decided Hogwarts could do without me after all. I don’t know whether they were planning to kill me or send me to Azkaban; either way, I knew it was time to disappear." "But," said Ron, looking thoroughly confused, "aren’t — aren’t we heading straight back into Hogwarts?"
Book7-chapter29_Sc3.description: I was proper confused — thought we were going back into Hogwarts, but Neville's gone missing to lay low. This mess is worse than I thought.

Book7-chapter29_Sc3.source: "She sent me a letter," he clapped a hand to the breast pocket of his robes, "telling me she was proud of me, that I’m my parents’ son, and to keep it up." "Cool," said Ron.
Book7-chapter29_Sc3.description: Neville's gran sent him a proud letter. That's brilliant and makes me glad for him.

Book7-chapter26_Sc1.source: “It’ll probably help you get in character, though,” said Ron. “Think what that wand’s done!”
Book7-chapter26_Sc1.description: Well, using Bellatrix’s wand will help Hermione get into character. Blimey, that wand has a nasty history, and that makes our disguise stronger.

Book7-chapter26_Sc1.source: “He could give my mother lessons,” growled Ron, as the goblin’s long fingers kept appearing around the edges of doors.
Book7-chapter26_Sc1.description: I don’t trust Griphook. His constant poking about makes me dead suspicious and fed up.

Book7-chapter26_Sc1.source: Ron, on the rare occasions that they had been able to snatch a few Griphook-free moments, had come up with nothing better than “We’ll just have to wing it, mate.”
Book7-chapter26_Sc1.description: I’m not sure how to double-cross Griphook either. We’ll just have to wing it, mate.

Book7-chapter26_Sc1.source: “Right, but remember, I don’t like the beard too long —” “Oh, for heaven’s sake, this isn’t about looking handsome —” “It’s not that, it gets in the way! But I liked my nose a bit shorter, try and do it the way you did last time.”
Book7-chapter26_Sc1.description: I care about small things in disguises. Don’t make the beard too long and shorten my nose a bit. I’m practical and fussy about this stuff.

Book7-chapter27_Sc5.source: "Maybe they’ll be too scared to tell him?"
Book7-chapter27_Sc5.description: Blimey, maybe people will be too terrified to tell him anything about the Horcruxes.
Bloody hell, they might try to hide things or cover up where the Horcruxes are.

Book7-chapter27_Sc5.source: "But what did you see? How do you know?"
Book7-chapter27_Sc5.description: What the hell did you see in his mind? How do you know where the Horcrux is?

Book7-chapter27_Sc5.source: "Did you see where in Hogwarts it is?"
Book7-chapter27_Sc5.description: Where in Hogwarts is the Horcrux? We need to know if we are going to get there in time.

Book7-chapter23_Sc1.source: "Stan Shunpike," said Ron. "Like 'ell you are," said the man called Scabior. "We know Stan Shunpike, 'e's put a bit of work our way."
Book7-chapter23_Sc1.description: I tried to bluff with a name, said I was Stan Shunpike. It didn't work. Bloody hell, they knew who he was.

Book7-chapter23_Sc1.source: "I’b Bardy," said Ron, and Harry could tell that his mouth was full of blood. "Bardy Weadley."
Book7-chapter23_Sc1.description: I slurred something like Bardy Weadley with my mouth full of blood, trying to keep up the act. Not my finest moment.

Book7-chapter23_Sc1.source: "This is all my fault. I said the name, I’m sorry —"
Book7-chapter23_Sc1.description: I felt awful and kept apologising because I said the Dark Lord's name and that may have led them straight to us. I blamed myself hard.

Book7-chapter23_Sc1.source: "We’b lebt," said Ron. "Left, 'ave you, ginger?" said Scabior. "And you decided to go camping? And you thought, just for a laugh, you’d use the Dark Lord’s name?" "Nod a laugh," said Ron. "Aggiden." "Accident?"
Book7-chapter23_Sc1.description: We were out camping after leaving Hogwarts and I kept trying to explain it was an accident, not some stunt. I kept sounding daft but I was desperate.

Book7-chapter32_Sc2.source: “Don’t even think about it,” Ron snarled at her.
Book7-chapter32_Sc2.description: Don’t even think about it. Blimey, I’m not letting her go under the Cloak. That’s my call.

Book7-chapter29_Sc5.source: It hasn't exactly been a picnic, mate
Book7-chapter29_Sc5.description: Blimey, it's been rough for us while we've been off doing this. I'm fed up but determined.
No, we're not leaving everyone to rot. I won't stand for that. Whatever we do has to help everyone in the end.

Book7-chapter29_Sc5.source: What we're doing will benefit everyone in the end, it's all about trying to get rid of You-Know-Who
Book7-chapter29_Sc5.description: We're doing this to get rid of You-Know-Who. I believe what we're doing will help everyone, even if they can't be told the details.
They can help. I whispered it to Hermione because I think the D.A. could make a real difference if they knew enough to act.

Book7-chapter29_Sc6.description: Blimey, what even is a diadem? I do not know that word.

Book7-chapter29_Sc6.source: [We’ve got to find it fast. We don’t have to tell them it’s a Horcrux.]
Book7-chapter29_Sc6.description: Right, we need to hurry and look for this thing. If telling everyone would make it harder, we do not have to say it is a Horcrux.

Book7-chapter32_Sc3.source: The tapestry at the top of the staircase on which they stood was ripped open.
Book7-chapter32_Sc3.description: Bloody hell, the tapestry just ripped open!

Book7-chapter32_Sc3.source: They ran down the next staircase and found themselves in a corridor full of duelers.
Book7-chapter32_Sc3.description: Blimey, what the hell? A whole corridor full of duelers!

Book7-chapter29_Sc4.source: Yeah, well, food’s one of the five exceptions to Gamp’s Law of Elemental Transfiguration
Book7-chapter29_Sc4.description: Blimey, food's one of those things magic won't make for you, so Aberforth has actually been keeping us fed. That's proper important to know.

Book7-chapter29_Sc4.source: It hasn’t exactly been a picnic, mate, said Ron
Book7-chapter29_Sc4.description: Look, I know it's been rough for everyone hiding here, but we've stuck together. We're loyal to Dumbledore and to you, Harry.

Book7-chapter29_Sc4.source: I never said it had, but I don’t see why you can’t trust us. Everyone in this room’s been fighting and they’ve been driven in here because the Carrows were hunting them down
Book7-chapter29_Sc4.description: We are Dumbledore's Army. Of course we want to help. Don't shut us out when we've proven we're on your side.

Book7-chapter32_Sc8.description: Blimey, they're having a right scrap and I'm at the back trying to keep up. I'm running too, following them off the steps.

Book7-chapter32_Sc5.source: [A fistful of tubers had hit the Cloak over Ron’s head; the slimy green roots were suspended improbably in midair as Ron tried to shake them loose.]
Book7-chapter32_Sc5.description: Blimey, Snargaluff pods will stick to the Cloak and cover you in slimy tubers. That was disgusting and nearly gave us away.

Book7-chapter32_Sc5.source: [“Someone’s invisible there!” shouted a masked Death Eater, pointing.]
Book7-chapter32_Sc5.description: What the hell, the Cloak makes things obvious if someone points. We can’t rely on it being completely safe when people are shouting.

Book7-chapter32_Sc11.source: [“How — how’re we going to get in?” panted Ron. “I can — see the place — if we just had — Crookshanks again —”]
Book7-chapter32_Sc11.description: I can see where we need to get in, and I really reckon if we'd had Crookshanks again he'd sort it out. Blimey, he would spot something.

Book7-chapter32_Sc11.source: [Ron looked around, then directed his wand at a twig on the ground and said, “Wingardium Leviosa!” The twig flew up from the ground, spun through the air as if caught by a gust of wind, then zoomed directly at the trunk through the Willow’s ominously swaying branches.]
Book7-chapter32_Sc11.description: Oh right yeah, I can do the levitation charm. Wingardium Leviosa works for shifting things into place, so that twig will do the job for us.

Book7-chapter31_Sc3.description: Crabbe's dead. That's brutal but he brought it on himself by setting Fiendfyre loose.

Book7-chapter31_Sc3.source: "Blimey, d’you reckon it’ll still work after that fire?"
Book7-chapter31_Sc3.description: Blimey, I was worried the Room of Requirement might be ruined, but the point is getting out and making sure everyone is alive.

Book7-chapter31_Sc3.source: "If he hadn’t tried to kill us all, I’d be quite sorry he was dead."
Book7-chapter31_Sc3.description: I can feel sorry for people sometimes, but not for someone trying to murder us. Crabbe had it coming.

Book7-chapter32_Sc6.source: “And that’s the second time we’ve saved your life tonight, you two-faced bastard!”
Book7-chapter32_Sc6.description: That's right, we've saved his life twice tonight, and I'm not letting him forget it, you two-faced git.

Book7-chapter32_Sc6.source: Ron punched him from under the Cloak. Malfoy fell backward on top of the Death Eater, his mouth bleeding, utterly bemused.
Book7-chapter32_Sc6.description: I punched Malfoy from under the Cloak, nailed him good, and he went straight on top of that Death Eater. Brilliant.

Book7-chapter32_Sc6.source: “How do we get out?” yelled Ron over all the screaming,
Book7-chapter32_Sc6.description: How do we get out of here? Blimey, everything's going mental and we need to move.

Book7-chapter32_Sc7.description: Don't cast a spell at it right now!

Book7-chapter32_Sc7.source: “Stun him and he’ll crush half the castle —”
Book7-chapter32_Sc7.description: Stunning that giant will just make it smash the castle. Blimey, don't do something that will make everything collapse.

Book7-chapter31_Sc2.description: It was my idea to use the basilisk venom from the Chamber of Secrets to destroy Horcruxes. Bloody brilliant if I say so myself.

Book7-chapter31_Sc2.source: "So we're another Horcrux down," said Ron, and from under his jacket he pulled the mangled remains of Hufflepuff’s cup.
Book7-chapter31_Sc2.description: So yeah, we destroyed another Horcrux. I kept the remains. I still can't believe we did it but I'm well chuffed.

Book7-chapter31_Sc2.source: Running at Ron, she flung them around his neck and kissed him full on the mouth. Ron threw away the fangs and broomstick he was holding and responded with such enthusiasm that he lifted Hermione off her feet.
Book7-chapter31_Sc2.description: Blimey, Hermione kissed me and I kissed her back. It's now or never, isn't it? We're together.

Book7-chapter31_Sc2.source: "No," said Ron seriously, "I mean we should tell them to get out. We don't want any more Dobbies, do we? We can't order them to die for us."
Book7-chapter31_Sc2.description: I don't want house-elves fighting and dying for us. We can't send them out to die. That's not on.

Book7-chapter32_Sc12.source: Harry, we’re coming, just get in there!
Book7-chapter32_Sc12.description: Blimey, I'm right behind you. We're coming with you, so get on with it and get in there.

Book7-chapter34_Sc6.source: "Ron and Hermione know that, but just in case they —"
Book7-chapter34_Sc6.description: Blimey, we all know about the Horcruxes. If anything happens to me or Hermione, Neville can step in so the secret stays with three people.
Kill the snake? Right, that's what we mean. If Harry gets a chance and they're busy, he has to take it and kill the snake. Simple as that.

Book7-chapter34_Sc6.source: "All right, Harry. You’re okay, are you?" "I’m fine."
Book7-chapter34_Sc6.description: Harry's determined and trying to stay calm. I'm worried but I'll keep backing him. We're in this together, no messing about.

Book7-chapter36_Sc8.description: What? Are you mental? I could not believe Harry wanted to give up the Elder Wand. It seemed mad to me.

Book7-chapter36_Sc8.source: Ron and Hermione looked at it with a reverence that, even in his befuddled and sleep-deprived state, Harry did not like to see.
Book7-chapter36_Sc8.description: Blimey, I was staring at the wand like it was something sacred. I was awed and worried about its power.

Book7-chapter36_Sc9.description: Blimey, are you sure about that? I wouldn't mind holding the Elder Wand, it looks proper tempting.
